clips.start_words: I remember it was a fellow
clips.caption:
A friend's wife called Kevin Trudeau in a panic. Her husband, a real estate investor, had been arrested and held on $250,000 cash bail - no bonds accepted, cash only.

They didn't have it. Kevin did. He called his pilots, flew down that night, and posted the full $250,000 himself.

His friend walked out in tears and said everyone he thought was a friend had vanished the moment he was arrested.

Kevin told him: pay me back whenever you can, or don't worry about it at all. He wasn't expecting the money back. He figured he was planting a seed and it would work out somehow.

When was the last time you helped someone with zero expectation of anything in return?

#kevintrudeau #givingback #karma #mindsetmatters #successmindset #generosity

Dale Carnegie was invited to a glamorous New York party, introduced to the room as 'the world's greatest conversationalist.'

The hostess rushed over and asked about his recent trip to Africa. Carnegie asked a question. She answered. He asked another. She talked. He leaned in, nodded, listened.

That was it. He barely said a word all night.

The next day she wrote in her society column that she'd spoken with the world's greatest conversationalist for twenty minutes, and it was true.

He never talked. He just made her feel like the only person in the room.

Who's the best listener you know?

#kevintrudeau #communication #socialskills #dalecarnegie #mindsetmatters #peopleskills

A friend of Kevin Trudeau's couldn't close an insurance sale no matter what he tried. He asked Kevin to tag along as his 'sales manager' just to watch.

The prospect opened with: you've got 10 minutes, I'm not interested, this is a courtesy.

Kevin scanned the room and spotted photos of the guy holding a huge marlin. He asked one question: 'Is that a picture of you fishing?'

The guy lit up and talked for ten straight minutes about the fight to land that fish. Kevin just listened and asked more questions.

Then the guy said it himself: 'All right, tell me about this insurance.' He became a big client.

What's on the wall of the next room you walk into?

#kevintrudeau #salestips #communication #businessmindset #peopleskills #networking
